decisions.reason: The authentication and identity delegation service was upgraded from a mention to a page of its own in 2024, which signals growing visible commitment and investment that management will want to justify rather than abandon.

The open GIS application development framework is central to the firm's announced GeoIT platform direction, so even though it remains only mentioned and has had little promotion, any weak uptake can be attributed to the time open-source adoption takes.

The identity service was publicly launched as new, has been promoted on a page of its own, and is core to integrating the firm's GIS applications, so the strong public and strategic commitment makes dropping it unlikely.

The geodata business process consulting workshop was only launched in 2024 with its own page, costs little to maintain, fits the firm's core consulting business, and any disappointing early results would be read as temporary.
